encoding: 196 lowercase hex digits; row-major; first pixel is most significant bit
generator: Python random.Random (MT19937); inclusive randint; class then train/validation/test
name: shapes
order: ascending label, then accepted draw order within each split
raster: integer masks; y increases downwards; axial/diagonal bands abs(offset)<stroke; square border max(abs(x),abs(y))>radius-stroke; ring (radius-stroke)^2<x^2+y^2<=radius^2; filled shapes ignore stroke and consume no stroke draw
uniqueness: reject repeated pixel arrays globally, including across labels and splits
